steps.en: Install the single lux binary and put FFmpeg on PATH
steps.zh: 装好 lux 这一个二进制，并把 FFmpeg 放进 PATH
steps.code: go install github.com/iawia002/lux@latest · brew install lux

steps.en: Run it on one or more video page URLs
steps.zh: 对一个或几个视频页面地址运行它

steps.en: Picks the extractor for that site and lists the available streams and sizes
steps.zh: 按站点挑出对应的抽取器，列出可用的清晰度和大小

steps.en: Downloads the top stream (or the one you pick), in parallel threads if you ask
steps.zh: 下载排在最前的流（或你指定的那个），要求时多线程并行

steps.en: Merges the downloaded parts into one video file with FFmpeg
steps.zh: 用 FFmpeg 把下好的分段合并成一个视频文件

value.en: One static binary turns a Bilibili/Douyin/YouTube page into a local video file, with no Python runtime to manage
value.zh: 一个静态二进制就能把 B 站、抖音、YouTube 页面变成本地视频文件，不用管 Python 运行时

sources: https://github.com/iawia002/lux#installation (FFmpeg prerequisite, go install github.com/iawia002/lux@latest, brew install lux)
https://github.com/iawia002/lux#getting-started (lux [OPTIONS] URL [URL...], -i lists streams, -f picks a stream)
